news.headline: USS Thomas Hudner Returns to Naval Station Mayport From Deployment
news.summary: The guided-missile destroyer USS Thomas Hudner returned to Naval Station Mayport, Fla., concluding an almost nine-month deployment across multiple geographic theaters, including the U.S. 4th, 5th and 6th Fleet areas of operations.

news.headline: Typhoon Dolphin Barrels Into China, Prompting Mass Evacuations

news.headline: In Malaysia, wave of hate speech threatens Rohingya refugees
news.summary: The spread of hostile content on social media in Malaysia has intensified tensions towards the Rohingya refugee community, leading to the eviction of more than 100 people from their village and the temporary closure of schools attended by refugee children.
